caseNameFull: McGoldrick, Comptroller of the City of New York v. Gulp Oil Corp.
attorneys: Messrs. William C. Chanler, Paxton Blair, and Sol Charles Levine for petitioner., Mr. Matthew S. Gibson for respondent..

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted. The judgment entered January 15, 1940, ante, p. 2, is vacated and the case is restored to the docket for reargument and assigned for hearing on Monday, February 26, next.
